reviews.title: Zero improvements in such a long time
reviews.text:
I have kept my five star rating literally for years, and I’ve been using WordUp since right about its launch, but the app seems to have stagnated, while the competition is crushing it. It seems they don’t listen to user feedback at all. Now I rarely even remember that I have a subscription on this app because I only use the vocabulary app by monkeytaps.

You guys have refused to take advantage of notification badges to send the words in the user’s collection as notifications, which reminds the user of the word. You’ve refused to take advantage of Home Screen and lock screen badges for daily words or word reminders. 

With other apps, you’re constantly learning your words both actively and passively, and they keep adding options to gamify the learning experience, and most importantly, they respond to reviews, and you literally get the improvements with new updates. Here, nothing is changing and it’s the same old system of spaced repetition and AI chat, which are amazing, but you can do SOOOOOO MUCH MORE, with the great app you built, but just won’t.

PS. This is still a great app , and I’ll return my five star ratings when you guys start making improvements again.

I really love everything. But there are 2 things I think are helpful if you add them.

First, one word can have several meanings, and I think it would be great if you allowed us to study all the meanings or choose which meaning of the word we want to study.

Second, in the custom word list, I think there should be more layers. For example, I can create a folder, and within that folder, I can create multiple lists. It helps users organize their stuff easily in the long term.

reviews.title: Removing the number
reviews.text: Thank you for your useful app, but I have one criticism: removing the number next to each word wasn’t a good decision. That number indicated the word’s level of usage and difficulty, and it was one of your strengths. It’s still visible on the word map, but it’s not shown during learning or even when searching for a word. Please bring it back in the next update—it was much better that way.
